name: yagi-ending-card
description: Produced by YAGI WORKSHOP — 3s cinematic end card (Remotion)

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts EndingCard renders/yagi-ending-16x9.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:vertical: remotion render src/index.ts EndingCardVertical renders/yagi-ending-9x16.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:alpha: remotion render src/index.ts EndingCard renders/yagi-ending-16x9-alpha.mov --codec prores --prores-profile 4444 --image-format png --props '{"transparent":true}'
scripts.render:fade: remotion render src/index.ts EndingCard renders/yagi-ending-16x9-fade.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --props '{"transparent":false,"reveal":"fade"}'
scripts.render:long: remotion render src/index.ts EndingCardLong renders/yagi-ending-10s-16x9.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:long:vertical: remotion render src/index.ts EndingCardLongVertical renders/yagi-ending-10s-9x16.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:long:alpha: remotion render src/index.ts EndingCardLong renders/yagi-ending-10s-16x9-alpha.mov --codec prores --prores-profile 4444 --image-format png --props '{"transparent":true}'
